subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should OpenClaw accept sidebar group-header management and a browser-profile Group by toggle through the linked web UI PR?
rationale: The request adds user-facing UI management and a persisted browser setting, and the protected maintainer label means cleanup automation should not decide the product direction.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Proceed with review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 and close this issue only after a satisfactory implementation merges.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Ask for only the group rename/delete/empty-section pieces first and defer the flat-list toggle or mobile parity.

options.title: Decline or defer
options.body: Leave the current sidebar grouping behavior unchanged and close both the issue and linked PR with a product-direction rationale.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 and close this issue only after a satisfactory implementation merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the original session grouping work and the open implementation PR for this issue.
